body:
Checklist-accuracy findings, fixture gaps and not-extracted observations for this record (card W2-C3b, wave anchor #25807, at `756220c4`). They were moved out of the body for size.

- **approvals.quorum-m-of-n rev 7:** steps[8] and acceptance[4] still say "drawer" and "the drawer's tally line". The Request cell opens the `sys_approval_request` record page, where the tally reads "Approvals — x of 2 · N eligible approvers". The fixture's admin-created reports make the admin both the submitter and the third holder; this is harmless and deserves a line in requires[1].
- **approvals.inbox-metadata-actions A1:** the override view renders "Override Recall" (and "Override Approve/Reject/Reassign"), not "Recall". Name the label.
- **approvals.decision-action-matrix A1:** the ≤500k budget-approve run also logs a `skipped` exec_review step after needs_exec. The discriminator holds.
- **automation.flow-node-type-matrix:**
  - steps[6]: the webhook intake accepts only the timestamped signature `t=UNIX,v1=HEX` over "t.rawbody". A body-only HMAC → 401 INVALID_SIGNATURE.
  - steps[1]: clone needs both `name` and `label`.
  - steps[3]: release_signoff `items` must be record-shaped `[{id,title}]`.
- **automation.rollup-summary-filter:**
  - steps[2]: the child's parent field is `expense_report`.
  - steps[6]: the editor lives at Studio Data › object › Form › summary field › Properties › "Filter (rows to aggregate)", and the edit is a draft until "Publish all".
- **api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix A5 / steps[6]:** the draft's promotion is refused as an `outcome:"refused"` entry inside publish-drafts' batch envelope, not as an HTTP 422.
- **identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle:**
  - The "API Keys" nav sits in a collapsed Developer group. Name the routes `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/sys_api_key/view/mine` and `…/com.objectstack.setup/sys_api_key/view/all_keys`.
  - Minting is two clicks: Generate key, then confirm.
- **identity-auth.self-signup-gate step 1:** `/login?redirect=/accept-invitation/ID` renders an "Accept your invitation" card with a "Create an account and join" link. It does not forward to `/register` automatically.
- **identity-auth.first-run-owner-bootstrap:**
  - The exit is two document loads to `/_console/` landing on `/_console/home`.
  - A `--no-seed-admin` boot seeds no demo personas.
- **access-security.capability-declaration-lifecycle:**
  - The surface is `mixed`, but no clause has a browser oracle.
  - The header comment of `examples/app-showcase/src/security/capabilities.ts` still says the declarations are "seeded into `sys_capability` at boot", which contradicts ADR-0131 D3 and the live 404.
- **access-security.public-form-intake A5:** the thank-you panel is partly covered by the "Submitted" toast. Read the panel text, or screenshot after the toast settles.
- **studio-authoring.view-authoring-live fixture:**
  - The object must carry the package namespace prefix (`NAMESPACE_PREFIX`).
  - `sharingModel` takes `private|public_read|public_read_write|controlled_by_parent`.
- **studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle:**
  - A3: the HTTP body code is `METADATA_CONFLICT`; the lower-case spelling is the audit row's.
  - A5 / steps[7]: the stray-key gate fires at the draft save (422), so the publish meets 404 NO_DRAFT.
  - A8: the diff is shallow by contract (path `widgets`), so "isolates the widget/dimension key" overstates it.
  - Draft discard is `DELETE /meta/TYPE/NAME?state=draft`.
- **studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu:** menu hrefs use `/apps/PACKAGE_ID/docs/…`, and the app-name form redirects there.
- **access-security.permission-matrix-edit-loop:**
  - steps[5] (the FLS flip) maps to no acceptance clause. Add a clause or drop the step.
  - The field-level controls sit behind each object row's expand chevron.
- **integration-system.webhook-lifecycle:**
  - The status column is `response_code` (the item says `lastStatusCode`), and the activation row carries `active` (the item says `enabled`).
  - `$filter` must be JSON.
  - A5's scratch builds need `requires: ['webhooks','realtime']`.
  - "The declaration still reads switched on" has no public read door: the meta read answers `isActive:false` (see the observations below). The working oracle is a post-reboot delivery row.
  - A terminal row needs a 4xx receiver.
- **i18n.strict-translation-key-rejection steps[3]:** a runner barred from the tree can require `packages/spec/dist` by absolute path from a scratch dir.
- **cli.scaffold-console-first-paint:**
  - `content/docs/getting-started/quick-start.mdx` carries no `create-objectstack` command.
  - The scaffolder prints `pnpm run dev` where the item says `npm run dev`; both work.
  - The published scaffold resolves 18.1.0, so the workspace console is not what this item proves (knownGaps[2]).
- **platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip:**
  - steps[13] expects `invalid_option` for `Mars/Phobos`; the live refusal is 400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION with `code: "value_domain"`.
  - steps[9]: no stock manifest has a user-scope secret, so only the 2-entry global chain is walkable.
  - An echoed mask on an env-locked secret answers 200 no-op, not 409.
- **records-forms.form-view-gallery:** deep-linking `/new` or `/edit` with a page load makes save's `navigate(-1)` leave the document and drop the toast. That is a driver artifact; steps could say to reach the route by in-app navigation.
- **records-forms.action-location-matrix:** knownGaps[2] was re-confirmed, and authoring now also refuses a throwing `visible`.
- **records-forms.field-group-visible-when:**
  - steps[1] must name the object with the namespace prefix (`groupgate_qa_group_gate`).
  - On the detail page the gate applies on save, not on an unsaved inline flip.
- **ux-conventions.write-feedback:**
  - steps[4] and variants[3]: the kanban refused-transition leg is no longer drivable. #25933's drop gate dims the blocked lanes (`data-kanban-drop-blocked`) and a drop sends nothing, so the validation-rule refusal needs another surface. The dimmed lane also carries no reason text (no title, no aria-describedby), which may need a ruling against "every disabled control explains why".
  - knownGaps / A1: the dialog-create row is no longer an expected FAIL now that #26172 has landed.
  - The import Undo uses a native `window.confirm`, while Studio discard uses an in-app dialog.
- **Shared recipe `search:qa-contributor-bound-member` step 5:** the first account `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account` returns is churned, so the invoice POST → 400 "This account has churned". Say to pick a non-churned account.
- **Environment (RUNNER facts):** `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/data/` is created, empty, by a boot that passes `-d file:…`. It is gitignored and harmless, and it is not the `installed-packages` trap.

Observations seen beside the clauses, no declared contract violated, not extracted (for the anchor's judgment):
- `sys_audit_log` keeps the full `sys_secret` row, ciphertext included, in `old_value`/`new_value` on create and delete. A rotated secret's AES-GCM ciphertext therefore stays readable by audit-log readers. No plaintext was found in any of 157 rows.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/webhook/showcase_task_changed` answers `isActive:false` while the activation ledger has it on and it delivers.
- An API key can mint further keys (`POST /api/v1/keys` with `x-api-key` → 201), so a leaked key can mint replacements that outlive its own revocation.
- Signing up again with an already-registered address that holds a pending invitation → 422 `USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL`, an account-existence signal limited to invited addresses.
- ⌘K palette: replacing the query in one shot (select-all plus a programmatic insert, or Playwright `fill`) leaves no item `aria-selected`, so Enter does nothing (2/2 each). Typing key by key always works (3/3). This is driver-sensitive (`automation-input`), so it is not confirmed as a user-facing defect.
- Search: `limit=0` and `limit=-1` are coerced to 1 (200, `truncated:true`) rather than refused, and `totalHits` reports the returned count.
- `GET /approvals/requests/ID/actions` answers 200 `[]` for a request the caller cannot see, where `GET /approvals/requests/ID` answers 404. No data leaks.
- A field-group `visibleWhen` with an unknown field saves 200 and fails closed at render, while the same predicate on an action `visible` is refused 422 at authoring. The two predicate slots are inconsistent at authoring time.

Four-way disposition of the one `fail`: `ux-conventions.write-feedback` A1 is a **product defect** in the showcase fixture's declared `successMessage`. It is not an assertion defect: the clause matches the maintainer ruling on #25849.

Supersede: this record re-judges 16 of #25817's 29 items (listed in the body). The other 13 belong to the sibling card W2-C3a, which had not filed a record when this one was filed. So under the card's rule ("whichever of the two cards finishes second") #25817 is NOT closed here. W2-C3a closes it with `Superseded-by:` naming both records, and carries forward any verdict neither record re-judged.

The #25822 retest: the fix holds for every reproduced shape except single-word language names (carded above as #26463, not a reopen).
